claude_proposed_widenings.name: persistent_activation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Call Lightning casts once (concentration, up to 10 min) and grants a repeatable Magic-action-costed activation each turn that fires a save_gate → area damage. No existing family (ongoing_effect, activation, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger) can express a concentration spell whose primary gameplay loop is a player-chosen repeatable action on each subsequent turn.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to call down lightning in that way again, targeting the same point or a different one.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate_ongoing_operation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The recurring lightning strike resolves through a DEX save_gate → area damage. The current OngoingOperation union only allows roll_modifier and damage_on_hit (attack-roll-keyed riders). There is no variant for a save-gated damage operation attached to a repeatable activation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature within 5 feet of that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: conditional_damage_bonus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The outdoor-storm +1d10 is a runtime context predicate (caster is outdoors in a pre-existing storm). This is neither slot-scaling nor level-scaling; it is a conditional bonus with no parallel in the current DiceAmount or scaling vocabulary.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're outdoors in a storm when you cast this spell, the spell gives you control over that storm instead of creating a new one. Under such conditions, the spell's damage increases by 1d10.
